caveat: It is a book review, so read it as a pointer to Rappaport's book rather than a source in itself.
title: Rappaport, J., Flórez, L., & Pérez "Altais", P. (2025). Historieta doble: A graphic history of participatory action research. University of Toronto Press.
venue: The Canadian Journal of Action Research
why: A review of a graphic history of PAR's Latin American origins - the lineage absence your ROOTS traces keep flagging, in a form you could put in front of students.
